- 2 -
The Cabinet shall hold weekly meetings
and shall meet at such other times as may be.
The Secretary to the President
shall preside.
Matters which have heretofore
been acted upon by the Cabinet shall continue
to be considered and decided by the Cabinet:
Provided, however, That in the absence of
unanimity of opinion on any question submitted,
no decision shall be taken until it shall have
been submitted to the President.
4. All official communications to the Pres-
ident, whether by letter or by cable, shall be
transmitted through or by the secretary to the
5. The Secretary to the President shall
preside over all official ceremonies, receive
and return the official calls of American and
foreign dignitaries in behalf of and in represent-
ation of the President.
Done at the City of Manila.
this Z6thday of
September, In the year or our lord, nineteen
hunared and forty-five, and of the Commonwealth
of the Philippines, the tenth.
SERGIO OSMAÑA
President of the Philippines
By the President:
Secretary to the Fresident
